ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown
on Map No. 13-G in the area bounded by

West Berwyn Ave; the public alley east of and parallel to North Clark Street; a
line 50 feet south of and parallel to West Berwyn Ave; North Clark Street

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common address: 5255-5259 N Clark Street, Chicago, [L and 1477 W Berwyn Ave, Chicago, IL
